postings.description:
Company Introduction: 

Mintel’s clients choose us because they know we’re drawing on Mintel data, knowledge, expertise, and insights that are rooted in the rigorous, multi-disciplinary research on which our reputation has been built. 

To support the business priorities of our top global and regional accounts, our Strategic Client Partnership Model provides high-growth, high-value clients with a dedicated team of experts, ensuring we can deliver tailored support aligned to their unique business needs. 

We are seeking a strategic Account Director for Strategic Partnership Accounts to own and grow a portfolio of these high-growth global and regional accounts, with a focus on deepening client relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, and building long-term value. 

What You Will Be Doing: 

You will own and grow a portfolio of Mintel’s largest and highest-value global and regional accounts. As the Account Director for Strategic Partnership Accounts, you will be responsible for renewing key client relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and positioning Mintel as a valued and preferred research partner. Day-to-day responsibilities include: 

- Owning the commercial relationship for key accounts in your market, working closely with global account managers to support best practices and drive growth across Mintel regions. 

- Building strong relationships across multiple levels of the client organization to identify opportunities for consultancy sales, contract upgrades, and long-term account growth. 

- Leading regular strategic reviews with internal stakeholders to track progress against account plans and adjust priorities where needed. 

- Developing and delivering creative business solutions that demonstrate ROI, strengthen client relationships, and support successful renewals. 

- Meeting commercial KPIs set by the APAC management team, including contract upgrades, consultancy sales, and renewal targets. 

- Maintaining accurate CRM records of client details, meetings, objectives, opportunities, and account activity. 

- Planning and executing a strategic reach-out plan aligned with the annual account plan. 

- Collaborating closely with internal business teams to ensure clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience across touchpoints. 

We Are Looking for People Who Are: 

- Commercially-minded: You can identify growth opportunities within existing client relationships and are comfortable leading conversations around renewals, upgrades, and consultancy solutions. 

- Relationship-driven: You enjoy building trusted partnerships with senior stakeholders and navigating complex client organizations. 

- Strategic and proactive: You are able to translate account goals into clear plans and take ownership of driving them forward. 

- Collaborative: You work effectively with global account managers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver the best client experience. 

- Client-focused: You are motivated by understanding client needs and showing how Mintel’s data, insights, and expertise can support their business goals. 

- Self-directed: You are comfortable managing priorities independently and taking accountability for the success of your account portfolio. 

- A strong communicator: You can adapt your communication style for different clients, seniority levels, and internal business partners. 

Must-Have Qualifications  

- 8+ years of experience in sales or account management  

- Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency  

- Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint  

Nice-to-Have Qualifications  

- Experience in the FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) industry  

- Experience in the Research industry

postings.title: Account Manager, Strategic Partner Accounts
postings.description:
At Mintel, we help businesses understand people, markets, and what comes next. As a global market intelligence agency, our understanding of consumers, innovation, and markets gives clients the clarity to act and the confidence to lead. With more than 50 years of expertise, we combine the real-world understanding of our experts with advanced technology to uncover patterns, anticipate change, and help organizations make smarter decisions.

As an Account Manager within the Strategic Partner Accounts team, you are responsible for driving client retention, growth, and value realization across a portfolio of global enterprise clients - including strategic anchor accounts, which span multiple business units, regions, and buying centers operating under a single global relationship. 

This is an individual contributor role with full ownership of renewal and expansion revenue targets. You will deliver proactive, high-touch engagement, ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes and continue to invest in their partnership with Mintel. On the most complex accounts, this includes managing risk and opportunity independently across multiple internal client stakeholders and organizational layers, rather than a single point of contact. 

You will work in close partnership with Global Account Directors and Lead Client Partners in a team-selling environment to align client value with commercial success. 

This is a Hybrid position based in Chicago

Key Responsibilities 

Renewal Ownership & Commercial Performance

- Own a defined portfolio renewal and growth target 

- Develop and execute account-specific renewal strategies based on demonstrated client value

- Maintain accurate renewal forecasts and pipeline visibility

- Deliver against retention and revenue expansion targets

- Track and defend renewal health at the sub-account level (business unit / region) as well as in aggregate, since a single global relationship can mask fragmented risk within individual divisions 

Contract Negotiation & Commercial Execution

- Lead renewal and contract negotiations, including procurement engagement 

- Build and present compelling commercial narratives linked to ROI and client outcomes

- Manage objections and position Mintel’s value effectively

- Close renewal and expansion deals to achieve target performance

- Navigate formalized, RFP-driven procurement processes and multi-year MSA/SOW structures typical of large, multi-divisional global organizations, including competitive vendor reviews 

Growth Opportunity Identification

- Identify upsell and consulting opportunities through structured discovery 

- Partner with Account Directors and Client Partners to convert opportunities into revenue

- Leverage client data and engagement signals to drive account growth

- Independently identify and coordinate opportunities that surface in different parts of the client organization (e.g., category management, innovation/R&D, e-commerce, sustainability), each with distinct insight needs and separate budget owners 

Success Planning & Value Delivery

- Own end-to-end Success Plans aligned to client business objectives 

- Define and track measurable outcomes and ROI

- Drive adoption strategies to ensure sustained engagement and value realization 

Client Engagement & Adoption

- Deliver proactive, structured engagement plans across assigned accounts 

- Facilitate training sessions and workshops to drive platform adoption

- Build and maintain strong, multi-level stakeholder relationships

- On accounts with layered global / regional / local structures, coordinate a consistent cadence and message across a wide network of individual contacts so the relationship stays coherent 

Client Health & Risk Management

- Monitor account health using usage, engagement, and feedback signals 

- Identify churn risks and implement mitigation plans

- Maintain consistent executive-level communication

- Monitor and reconcile health signals that may vary significantly across business units or regions within a single account 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with internal teams (Insights, Product, Consulting, Operations) to deliver client outcomes 

- Contribute to coordinated global account strategies

- Act as the internal orchestration point across multiple Mintel service lines engaged concurrently on different parts of the same account, ensuring internal teams present a unified front 

Success Measures 

Success in this role is evaluated through:

- Portfolio retention rate (%) 

- Net revenue retention (NRR) / revenue growth

- Renewal and expansion revenue achievement vs. target

- Client adoption and engagement metrics (e.g., active users, usage frequency)

- Demonstrated client ROI and value realization

- Stakeholder relationship strength (including executive engagement)

- Volume and quality of consulting lead generation

- Sub-account / business-unit-level retention, in addition to aggregate portfolio retention, on accounts with multi-divisional structures 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Client-focused mindset with strong understanding of enterprise client needs 

- Commercial accountability with experience owning revenue or renewal targets

- Strategic thinking and analytical capability to translate usage data into business value

- Negotiation skills, including experience working with procurement stakeholders

- Executive presence with ability to influence senior stakeholders

- Strong discovery skills to uncover client needs and growth opportunities

- Collaborative approach within cross-functional environments

- Self-directed and accountable for both client and commercial outcomes

- Excellent communication skills, adaptable across levels and regions

- Technology and data fluency to articulate insight-led value

- Organizational agility to manage relationships and priorities across multiple business units, regions, and buying centers within a single account 

Experience & Qualifications

- 5+ years’ experience managing enterprise or global client relationships 

- Demonstrated experience owning or contributing to renewals, revenue targets, or quota achievement

- Experience in complex, multi-stakeholder environments

- Proven capability in contract negotiation, objection handling, and closing deals

- Familiarity with customer success methodologies and value-based engagement models

- Experience managing large, matrixed, multi-divisional global accounts (e.g., Fortune 100 CPG or similar) with formal, competitive procurement functions

- Create and manage outbound campaigns to generate new sales opportunities.

- Understand prospects' business objectives, challenges, and growth priorities through effective discovery conversations.

- Drive opportunities through the full sales cycle, from prospecting to negotiation and contract closure.

Negotiation

- Lead commercial discussions and negotiations with senior stakeholders.

Forecasting & Reporting

You are a metrics-driven sales professional with a proven track record of winning new business. You are confident making cold calls, developing new relationships, and opening doors at all levels of an organization. Strategic & Forward Thinking

You enjoy uncovering client needs through thoughtful questioning and consultative conversations. You are skilled at identifying underlying business challenges and translating them into actionable opportunities.

Resilient & Adaptable

You possess the determination and resilience required to thrive in a highly competitive sales environment. You view setbacks as learning opportunities and remain focused on achieving results despite challenges.

Great Communicators

You are an effective communicator with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. You know how to tailor your message to different audiences and can confidently engage stakeholders ranging from managers to C-suite executives.

Team Player

You build strong relationships internally and collaborate effectively with colleagues across sales, account management, consulting, insights, marketing, and client success teams.

Experience & Requirements

- Proven track record of prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing complex sales opportunities.

postings.title: Collections Specialist
postings.description:
The Collections Specialist is responsible for managing overdue accounts, ensuring timely payments from customers, and supporting accurate cash application activities. They contact clients to follow up on outstanding invoices, negotiate payment plans, resolve billing issues, and assist with allocating customer payments against open invoices. They also maintain accurate records of collection efforts, collaborate with internal teams to address disputes, and ensure compliance with company policies and regulations. Their goal is to minimize bad debt and improve cash flow for the organization.

Responsibilities:

- Monitor accounts receivable aging and proactively follow up on overdue invoices.

- Execute collection activities including reminder emails, phone calls, and escalation in line with collection strategy.

- Resolve payment issues such as invoice disputes, short payments, unapplied cash, and cash application queries in coordination with relevant teams.

- Support cash application activities, including matching and applying customer receipts to invoices, investigating unidentified payments, and clearing unapplied or misapplied cash items on a timely basis.

- Negotiate payment plans and settlement terms within approved authority limits.

- Prepare regular collection status reports and escalate high-risk or long-outstanding accounts.

- Prepare monthly AR ageing analysis to highlight overdue balances, collection risks, account movements, and required follow-up actions for management review.

- Support weekly PO reporting by tracking PO status, following up on missing or pending purchase orders, and coordinating with internal stakeholders to support timely billing and collections.

- Identify potential bad debt risks and support provision and write-off processes.

- Maintain and enforce standardized credit and collection procedures. Ensure collection activities comply with internal policies, local regulations, and audit requirements.

- Document collection actions and customer communications accurately in ERP system.

- Prepare and maintain dashboards and reports to track Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), aging and collection effectiveness, promise-to-pay conversion and average days delinquent.

- Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance collection efficiency and DSO performance.

- Support annual audits by providing collection documentation and account reconciliations.

- Perform any other ad-hoc duties as assigned by superior.

Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in credit and collections.

- Strong understanding of accounts receivable, credit management, and collection processes.

- Prior experience in SSC (Shared Service Centre) or multinational company.

postings.title: Principal, Data & AI Integration
postings.description:
Mintel is the world’s leading market intelligence agency. Increasingly, our clients don’t come to Mintel; Mintel goes to them. They use our research and data inside their own systems — through AI assistants and agents, APIs, data feeds, dashboards and internal research tools — and combine it with their own business data and third-party data. Clients who work this way stay with us longer and get more from us, and the integrations that make it possible are already live. 

This is the next frontier for Mintel, and we are hiring someone to make it excellent. You will understand how clients integrate Mintel into their own ecosystems and make sure what we deliver doesn’t just work, but fits the way they actually work: from the question a client asks in their own tool, through what Mintel returns, to what they do with the answer next. 

This is not a traditional product or UX role. Mintel does not own the end user experience in an integration; our clients do. What we own is what we send: how our content, data and capabilities are structured, described and delivered so they are usable, trustworthy and recognisably Mintel in environments we don’t control. 

A large part of your time will be spent with clients: understanding their workflows and what they are trying to achieve, seeing how Mintel actually shows up in their work, and removing the obstacles that stand between them and the value. The rest is turning what you learn into what we return. Our engineers own the integration’s code; you own what it should return. 

You will work hand in hand with our Senior Director, Data Product. Together you decide what is on offer: she owns whether the data is ready and reliable; you own how it works from the client’s side and whether it achieves their goal. Neither ships without the other. You will also work daily with our engineers, architects and product managers. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role. It carries no team. It is principal-level because the work has to move engineers, product managers and the data team without authority over any of them. 

What you’ll do 

Understand clients and what they are really trying to achieve 

- Take a consultative approach: run client discovery, observe workflows, and dig past the requested feature to the outcome behind it. Most clients want to innovate faster; the interesting part is how differently each one goes about it.

- Understand how clients combine Mintel with their own and third-party data, and where their systems and processes get in the way.

- Decide what we standardise and what we tailor: find the patterns that work for many clients and recognise when an individual client genuinely needs something different.

- Build a library of real use cases, case studies and representative client scenarios that shapes product decisions and equips our commercial teams.

Shape the integration experience 

- Own the integration-facing contract, in partnership with Data Product: what we expose, what it is called, how it is described and what each element carries, so that whatever a client’s system composes is clear, traceable and valuable.

- Set the standard for a good integration experience and review new Mintel capabilities against it, so integration is part of discovery rather than an afterthought.

- Collaborate closely with Data Product and Engineering to turn client evidence into the roadmap and into real improvements, not just recommendations.

Evaluate and improve 

- Test how Mintel capabilities actually appear and perform in representative client environments, before and after every change. 

- Watch what assistants and systems actually call, where they fail and where they fall silent, and keep a set of real client questions to run against every change. An assistant that stops finding Mintel useful never tells you.

- When something comes out wrong, work out whether the cause is the integration-facing definition, the returned output, the data or the client’s implementation, and bring in the right owner. 

Develop best practice and enablement 

- Give clients practical guidance and examples when they are still shaping their integration approach, without designing or building their specific system. 

- Help Sales and Account Management understand the shift from websites to integrations: what is possible, what is not, and which delivery route fits which need. 

- Contribute to Mintel’s thought leadership on integration experiences. 

What we’re looking for 

This role combines client discovery, product thinking, information design and technical fluency. We are specifically looking for a mix of experience across technical solution consulting, API-first or integration products, and AI-assisted or data-rich products, in whatever combination you have built it. Few people have all of it from one job; most of the people we want have crossed at least one boundary. 

You will need: 

- A consultative mindset and an appetite for clients. Expect around 30% of your time talking to clients and, where it helps, travelling to see their workflows first-hand. You are genuinely interested in unblocking individual clients, and you turn each one into something that works for many. You have to want this, not tolerate it. 

- Technical fluency. You can read an integration and the data it returns, and test it the way a client’s system would. You understand APIs, MCP, AI assistants, authentication and data exchange, and you pick up new tools quickly as the landscape changes. You are not here to build the integration; our engineers do that, and they will treat you as a peer because you understand their work. 

- Information design. You can look at the raw data behind an answer and say whether a client reading it would trust it, and restructure it so they would. This is design applied to data, not to screens.

- Product judgement. You balance client needs, business goals, data constraints and technical reality, and explain the trade-offs clearly. 

- Influence without authority. You create alignment across Product, Data Product, Engineering, Architecture and Commercial teams, and you communicate well with technical and non-technical audiences, including clients. 

It helps if you have: 

- Worked on API, platform, data-sharing or integration products, or on products consumed inside customer-controlled tools. 

- Experience with AI-assisted workflows, enterprise search or knowledge platforms. 

- Developed standards, case studies or practices that other teams adopted.

Before you apply, four things to know: 

- This is an individual-contributor role. There is no team to manage, now or planned.

- There are no screens. The design work is in what our integrations return: the data, its structure and how it is described.

- You decide what the integrations should return; our engineers build them. If you would rather be building, this isn’t the role.

- The role will change shape as the technology and our clients do. You will be defining it as you go, not inheriting a settled job.

What you'll get in return: 

- A culture that supports true collaboration whilst embracing remote working with a company wide hybrid working week.

- Approach to personal development where we encourage individuals to grow and share what they’ve learned.

- Social events, both within the department and across the company

- Generous holiday allowance with the opportunity to buy back additional holiday.

- A day off to celebrate your birthday

- Giving back is part of our culture with this in mind Mintel gives each employee 2 days per year to give to a worthwhile cause.

We believe that understanding the domain is essential to building genuinely useful AI applications rather than simply applying technology to a problem. 

This role involves working with global stakeholders across different time zones. From time to time, you may be required to attend meetings outside your normal working hours. We support flexible working arrangements, allowing you to adjust your working hours accordingly when this is needed.

Why join Mintel? 

We are the world's leading market intelligence agency and technology underpins our success. We help our clients understand consumers and consumer markets, and we aspire to provide the market intelligence behind every great business decision. Our technology allows us to deliver data, insights, and opinions in a compelling way to our clients across the globe. 

Mintel is committed to building and supporting a diverse workforce, providing opportunities for all. 22% of our Engineering team and 23% of our Engineering leaders are women. We offer flexible working options and provide support, development and growth opportunities. 

We support a hybrid working approach. Most of our colleagues work three days a week in our KL office and the rest of the week remotely.

What You Will Do 

- Build, test, deploy, and maintain production full-stack applications, working across React and TypeScript frontends, Python services using FastAPI or Django, SQL databases, APIs, authentication, and system integrations. 

- Design and implement Agentic AI capabilities, including LLM orchestration, tool use, workflows, retrieval, structured outputs, and other patterns required to integrate generative AI into production applications. 

- Contribute to the evaluation of LLM and Agentic AI systems, helping define evaluation datasets and meaningful quality criteria, implementing automated evaluations, analysing failures and regressions, and using the results to improve system performance. 

- Contribute to technical design and system architecture, considering factors such as maintainability, scalability, reliability, security, performance, and observability. 

- Deploy and operate applications in cloud environments, contributing to CI/CD, application configuration, monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and production support. Our applications primarily operate in AWS. 

- Develop a strong understanding of the market research and consulting domain, working with consultants and other business stakeholders to understand their workflows, the problems they solve for clients, and where AI and automation can provide meaningful value. 

- Translate business problems into practical technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and helping them understand what is technically feasible. 

- Develop features and solve technical problems as part of an Agile team, working independently where appropriate while also pairing and collaborating with other Engineers and Architects. 

- Help deliver high-quality, reliable software through testing, code reviews, QA practices, documentation, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices. 

- Participate actively in technical discussions, contributing your perspective when evaluating implementation approaches, technical trade-offs, and potential solutions. 

What We Are Looking For

- Professional experience building and deploying production software applications. We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on applications used by real users, rather than experience limited primarily to personal projects, hackathons, or proof-of-concepts. 

- Good full-stack software engineering skills, with experience in backend development using Python and technologies such as FastAPI or Django, together with SQL, APIs, authentication, and system integrations. 

- Experience with, or a willingness to work across, frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript. You do not need to be equally specialised in every part of the stack. 

- Hands-on experience building applications with generative AI or LLMs, with an understanding of concepts such as prompting, tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, agents, and LLM orchestration.

- Experience with LLM evaluation, or a strong understanding of evaluation approaches for LLM-based applications, including concepts such as evaluation datasets, quality metrics, deterministic evaluation, human evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge, and regression testing. 

- An understanding of the challenges involved in moving generative AI beyond prototypes and into production, including reliability, observability, error handling, security, latency, cost, and the non-deterministic nature of LLM-based systems. 

- A good foundation in system design and software architecture, with an understanding of areas such as API design, data flows, application boundaries, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability. 

- Exposure to DevOps and cloud environments, including areas such as application deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and debugging production issues. Hands-on AWS experience is particularly valuable. 

- A product and problem-solving mindset. You should be interested in understanding the underlying problem and user workflow rather than simply implementing the requested technology. 

- The ability and willingness to quickly develop domain knowledge. Previous experience in market research or consulting is not required, but you will be expected to learn how our consultants work and use that knowledge when designing solutions. 

- The ability to work independently while knowing when to collaborate or seek input, taking ownership of your work and driving technical problems through to resolution. 

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different business stakeholders without losing important context or relying unnecessarily on technical jargon.

Nice to have 

- Experience with Agentic AI frameworks or SDKs such as OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies.

- Experience implementing automated LLM evaluation pipelines as part of the development lifecycle or CI/CD process.

- Experience with AWS infrastructure and services used to deploy production web applications. 

- Experience designing or operating distributed, asynchronous, or event-driven systems. 

- Experience working closely with consulting, research, analytics, or other knowledge-intensive business teams. 

 What We Offer

- A culture that supports true collaboration whilst embracing remote working. 

- Flexible start times and end times. 

- Approach to personal development where we encourage individuals to grow and share what they’ve learned. 

- Social events, both within the department and across the company. 

- Generous annual leave and wider circle employee benefits. 

- Additional one day off to celebrate your birthday. 

- Membership in Employee Resource Groups (Mintel Diversity, Mintel Wellness, and Mintel Gives). 

- Giving back is part of our culture with this in mind, Mintel gives employees 2 days' leave per year to join local volunteering activities organised by our Mintel Gives (where applicable). 

- Mental health and wellbeing support via Modern Health App. 

- Beautifully designed offices foster collaboration and fun.

Standort: Düsseldorf 
Arbeitszeit: 18 Stunden pro Woche / nach Absprache 

Stundenlohn von 17€/Std

Über die Rolle 

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir einen engagierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der sowohl unser Vertriebsteam als auch das Office Management bei organisatorischen, administrativen und operativen Aufgaben unterstützt. Die Position bietet einen abwechslungsreichen Einblick in die Bereiche Sales, Business Development und Büroorganisation innerhalb eines internationalen Unternehmens. 

Deine Aufgaben 

Bereich Sales 

- Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben 

- Recherche und Analyse potenzieller Kunden, Märkte und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten 

- Pflege und Aktualisierung von CRM-Systemen sowie Vertriebsdatenbanken 

- Vorbereitung von Kundenterminen, Präsentationen und Vertriebsunterlagen 

- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Angeboten, Kundenpräsentationen und internen Dokumentationen 

- Durchführung von Datenanalysen und Rechercheprojekten für das Sales-Team 

- Unterstützung bei der Planung und Organisation von Kundenbesuchen und Veranstaltungen 

- Nachbereitung von Meetings sowie Dokumentation relevanter Informationen und Aufgaben 

Bereich Office Management & Administration 

- Unterstützung bei organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben des Düsseldorfer Büros 

- Bearbeitung, Weiterleitung und Verwaltung von Post, Rechnungen und weiteren Dokumenten 

- Unterstützung der internen Kommunikation und teamübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit 

- Organisation und Durchführung interner Veranstaltungen, Workshops und Team-Events 

- Unterstützung bei Büro- und Facility-Themen sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit Dienstleistern und Lieferanten 

- Pflege administrativer Prozesse und Unterstützung bei laufenden Projekten 

Dein Profil 

- Laufendes Studium an einer Hochschule oder Universität 

- Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise 

- Organisationstalent und hohe Serviceorientierung 

- Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office 

- Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch und Englisch (C1 Niveau) 

- Interesse an Vertriebsprozessen, Business Development und administrativen Abläufen 

- Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude daran, verschiedene Teams gleichzeitig zu unterstützen 

Das bieten wir 

- Vielfältige Einblicke in die Bereiche Sales, Business Development und Office Management 

- Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit hoher Sichtbarkeit im Unternehmen 

- Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams 

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit dem Studium vereinbaren lassen 

- Moderner Büroraum im Düsseldorfer Medienhafen 

Bitte laden Sie Ihren Lebenslauf auf Englisch hoch.
